Brief: Tell me how MangoDB evaluates a find query with a filter. — about getValuesByPath (src/document-utils.ts)

1. * Get all possible values from a document using dot notation.
2. * @description Retrieves all values matching a dot-notation path. When traversing arrays with
3. * non-numeric path segments, returns values from all matching elements. This matches MongoDB's
4. * query behavior for nested arrays.
5. * @param doc - The document to query
6. * @param path - Dot-notation path (e.g., "user.address.city", "items.0.name")
7. * @returns Array of all values found at the path (may include undefined)
8. * @example
9. * const doc = { items: [{ name: "A" }, { name: "B" }] };
10. * getValuesByPath(doc, "items.name") // ["A", "B"]
11. * getValuesByPath(doc, "items.0.name") // ["A"]
12. * getValuesByPath(doc, "user.email") // [undefined]

Which sentence is most worth keeping for the brief? Reply {"sentence": "<number>"} or {"sentence": "none"}.
